subject.title: docs: add product one-liner to AGENTS.md Start

question: Should root AGENTS.md include a durable product-and-architecture orientation line, or remain limited to operational policy and routing?
rationale: Repository evidence can establish that the central wording is accurate, but it cannot determine the intended long-term editorial boundary of this heavily maintained root policy file.

options.title: Keep canonical orientation
options.body: Accept a minimal README-aligned line that gives agents immediate context without adding unstable implementation details.

options.title: Keep policy-only scope
options.body: Decline the insertion and continue treating README.md as the canonical product overview.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical orientation
recommendation.body: Accept a minimal README-aligned line that gives agents immediate context without adding unstable implementation details.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the dominant recent contributor to root AGENTS.md and the strongest evidence-backed owner for its editorial scope.
